name: Scary Teacher 3D Classic
desc:
If you enjoy it, leave a like! 👍

🎒 Step into the shoes of a clever student on a mission to prank your scary teacher, Miss T. 😈 She's strict, mean, and totally unfair and it's time to get some payback! 💥

🏠 Explore her house, find hidden items, and set up sneaky tricks to surprise her. 🕵️‍♂️ But be careful she's always on the lookout! 👀 Outwit her and enjoy the hilarious reactions. 😂

💡 Can you outsmart Miss T and teach her a lesson she won't forget?
